q: What type of flashing is formed from metal or elastomeric sheeting and is secured to a wall, curb, pipe, or other surface to cover and protect the upper edge of a base flashing and its fasteners?
n: Per the MST answer key: Counterflashing.

q: What beveled piece at a roof-to-wall junction gives the flashing a smooth transition?
n: A cant strip avoids a sharp 90° bend in the membrane.

q: What wall type is needed when a basement is built?
n: Basement walls retain earth.

q: What is the most suitable approach for exterior basement walls below grade?
n: Waterproofing the wet (outer) face is most effective.

q: What is the best material to waterproof the outside of a basement wall before backfill?
n: Bituminous sheets handle soil contact and water pressure.

q: Which waterproofing approach is used when access to the exterior of a basement wall is not possible?
n: Negative-side waterproofing is applied from the inside when the outer face can't be reached.

q: What is laid along the base of basement walls to collect and carry groundwater away?
n: A perforated pipe in gravel (French drain) relieves water pressure.

q: Elastoseal is made by which company?
n: Elastoseal is a Pioneer product.

q: Which brand makes the cementitious waterproofing Plexibond?
n: Plexibond is a Boysen product.

q: What local brand in the Philippines is commonly associated with waterproofing membranes and sealants for roof decks and wet areas?
n: Bostik is best known for sealants and membranes for roof decks and wet areas.

q: Which of the following is a two-component, flexible cementitious waterproofing membrane manufactured by Buildrite?
n: Per the MST answer key: Flexicrete.

q: Which of these insulation materials is lightest?
n: Expanded polystyrene is mostly air.

q: Which of these is the most expensive insulation?
n: Polyurethane foam costs the most of the four.

q: Which insulation is commonly fitted between wall studs?
n: Batts are cut to fit stud cavities.

q: Which insulation is made from polyethylene?
n: Per the MST answer key: Membrane.

q: Which insulation suits people with asthma best?
n: Polyester fiber doesn't shed irritants.

q: Of these four, which insulation costs the most to install?
n: Spray foam needs equipment and skilled crews.

q: Which insulation seals walls against both moisture and air?
n: Sprayed foam fills every gap.

q: Which insulation material has the highest resistance to water vapor?
n: Per the MST answer key: XPS.

q: Which insulation is commonly used under roofing?
n: Foil laminates are the standard roof underlay.

q: Which insulation has the lowest R-value on its own but performs well with an air cavity?
n: Foil works by low emissivity across an air gap.

q: What is the correct order of layers in a roof system, from top?
n: Insulation is laid over the purlins, just under the sheet.

q: Which insulation type typically does not come with a 50-year warranty?
n: Per the MST answer key: Spray foam.

q: What is the most affordable roof insulation suited to the tropics?
n: Foil is cheap and blocks radiant heat, the main load in the tropics.

q: Which insulation contains about 50% recycled PET?
n: Polyester batts use recycled bottles.

q: In a vaulted ceiling, where does insulation go?
n: With no attic, insulation fills the rafter spaces.
